title: Home practical guide and safety card: ruler-drop reaction test
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
unit: Spring 2: Transport, the periodic table and waves
source: Written for gcse-science/y10 lesson 32 (Home practical guide and safety card: ruler-drop reaction test (portal worksheet; plastic ruler, sit down))
intro: Lesson 32: Coordination: the nervous system and reflexes. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To measure reaction time with a ruler drop
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Sit with your arm on a table, hand over the edge
Your helper holds the ruler with 0 cm level with your thumb and finger
They drop it without warning; catch it
Read the distance where you caught it
Repeat five times; then try your other hand
Use the mean; a shorter distance means a faster reaction

questions.q: Big question: how do you move your hand before feeling pain?
questions.a: A reflex arc through the spinal cord bypasses the conscious brain.
